title: APRS Heard-Station Map and Dead Spots
dataSources: Aircraft messages (`adsb:message`), APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), AIS vessel messages (`ais:message`), rtl_433 decodes (`rtl433:sensor`), RF occupancy summaries (`sdr:spectrum`), satellite observations (`satnogs:observation`), and repeater use (`repeater:activity`).
app: Radio and SDR telemetry from WSPR, APRS, ADS-B, AIS, rtl_433, SatNOGS, and local receiver health feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and log shippers.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aprs:packet
| stats dc(callsign) as stations_heard count as packets by grid
| sort - stations_heard
description: Shows which APRS grid squares you hear well and which areas stay sparse or silent.
value: Coverage maps help tune antennas and placement by turning APRS listening into a measurable hearing footprint.
implementation: Stream APRS packets with grid-square enrichment from APRS-IS or your local digipeater feed.
visualization: Grid map of distinct stations heard and packet volume.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which areas your APRS radio setup hears well and where its coverage falls off.
